constraints: If printOptions is omitted, the default 4D Write Pro layout is used and expressions are recomputed before printing (wk 4D Write Pro layout + wk recompute expressions).
Page margins always come from the 4D Write Pro document's own page settings, regardless of print settings from 4D PRINT SETTINGS/SET PRINT OPTION.
If called between OPEN PRINTING JOB and CLOSE PRINTING JOB, the document is added to the current print job instead of launching a new one.
